setup.playersHint: Tap the colours that are playing.

problem.players: Choose at least 3 colours (Cryptid needs 3–5 players).

me.spectatorHint: As a spectator you know no clue: the board shows what can be deduced from the markers alone. Pick your colour to enter your clue and get advice.

play.keys: Keys: <kbd>Y</kbd> <kbd>R</kbd> <kbd>G</kbd> <kbd>C</kbd> <kbd>P</kbd> pick a colour's cube (with <kbd>Shift</kbd>, its disc) · <kbd>Space</kbd> disc/cube · arrows + <kbd>Enter</kbd> place · <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Z</kbd> undo · <kbd>?</kbd> all keys

advice.spectator: You are a spectator: pick your colour and clue in the Me tab to get advice.

match.othersRandom: The AIs get the other colours at random.
match.keys: Keys: <kbd>A</kbd> ask · <kbd>S</kbd> search · a colour's letter picks whom · arrows + <kbd>Enter</kbd> choose the hex
